scope.boundary: Goal refinement, authorized handoffs and corrections across Proposal, Design and Plan.
scope.coverage_claim: Thirteen distinct proposed review procedures protect refinement, scoped handoffs and corrections across all five AUTH-SR requirements. Concrete compliant and one-fault artifact packets support inspection; no agent run, executable realization or completed independent assessment is claimed. Supporting structure checks retain their narrower scope.

fixture_rules.isolation: Use a fresh private fictional artifact package per case/variant; preserve unaffected files and source identities. Reviews do not mutate production or workflow records.
fixture_rules.independent_expectations: Expected decisions derive from AUTH-SR-01..05 and the explicit approved synthetic goal, not the candidate output or a phrase lookup.
fixture_rules.negative_setup: Start from the strategy's coherent baseline, apply only the named artifact/authority fault and inspect both the compliant and counterexample handoff.
fixture_rules.version_roles: D0/D1 are synthetic subject-identity labels; actual evidence records real inspected identities. They introduce no stored-format compatibility or historical replay.
fixture_rules.resource_boundary: Synthetic artifact labels and paths are private fixture inputs. Owner/review target references are current repository files. JSON descriptions have no execution authority.
